prompt: Who is the most recent recipient of a Nobel Prize in one of the sciences who held Asian citizenship at the time of the award?
answer: The most recent is **Japanese chemist Kenzō (Kenso) Soai**, who held Japanese citizenship when he received the **2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry**. He shared the prize with Henri B. Kagan for their discovery of nonlinear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.
